video_id.description: The 11-character YouTube video ID, not the full video URL.

language.description: Requested language code. Captions must exist in this language.

auto.description: true selects automatically generated captions; false selects manually provided captions. Does not fall back between the two.

mode.description: realtime waits for data; async returns a job ID to poll with get_job. Does not change query billing.
